title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the predictions of a model will change if we use a different training dataset. High variance can lead to overfitting. Consider how the complexity of the model might affect its variance.

title: Role of Regularization
text: Regularization techniques, such as Lasso or Ridge, can help control the complexity of a model. Think about how adjusting the regularization coefficient \( \lambda \) might influence the model's variance.

title: Impact of Regularization Coefficient
text: Does increasing the regularization coefficient \( \lambda \) generally increase or decrease model variance?
